mapper.select: SELECT NVL(SUM(check_count), 0) AS checkCount, -- 检查人次 ROUND(AVG(NVL(on_time_rate, 0)), 2) || '%' AS onTimeRate, -- 准时率 MAX(wait_time) AS waitTime, -- 等候时长 MAX(avg_wait_late) AS avgWaitLate, -- 平均迟到 MAX(avg_report_time) AS avgReportTime -- 平均报告时长 FROM TR_MEDTECH_OV WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}

SELECT dept_name AS deptName, -- 科室名称 NVL(SUM(check_count), 0) AS checkCount, -- 检查人次 ROUND(AVG(NVL(on_time_rate, 0)), 2) || '%' AS onTimeRate, -- 准时率 ROUND(AVG(NVL(wait_time, 0)), 2) AS waitTime, -- 等候时长 ROUND(AVG(NVL(avg_wait_late, 0)), 2) AS avgWaitLate, -- 平均迟到 ROUND(AVG(NVL(avg_report_time, 0)), 2) AS avgReportTime -- 平均报告时长 FROM TR_MEDTECH_DTL d WHERE d.stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY d.dept_name ORDER BY checkCount DESC
